title: PardoGarcia2026: Mu/beta motor-imagery EEG in chronic MCA stroke and healthy controls
description: Pre-execution, two-class hand motor-imagery EEG (precision pinch vs closed fist) from 10 chronic middle cerebral artery stroke patients, recorded at baseline and after rehabilitation, and 8 healthy controls. Recordings used 63 BrainVision channels at 1000 Hz. The data support analysis of mu and beta oscillatory changes (event-related desynchronization) during motor preparation and imagery. This is a BIDS re-release produced via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainVision (Brain Products) system using an Electro-Cap 10-10 montage with Ag/AgCl electrodes, 63 channels (59 EEG, 4 EOG) sampled at 1000 Hz and referenced to the right mastoid. Participants viewed image cues for a precision pinch or closed fist and imagined and prepared the grip. Overt execution followed a later auditory go cue and is outside the exposed interval. Trials cover 0-1.5 s.
